scripts.build: pnpm --filter @chat/contracts build && pnpm --filter @chat/api build && pnpm --filter @chat/web build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @chat/contracts build && pnpm --filter @chat/api check && pnpm --filter @chat/web check && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm generate:check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @chat/contracts build && pnpm --filter @chat/api test && pnpm --filter @chat/web test
scripts.generate: pnpm --filter @chat/contracts build && pnpm --filter @chat/api openapi && node scripts/generate-api-client.mjs
